body: Chief: new bead assigned, and it is P1 - a read-only estimand audit of the WHOLE interview scoring surface, looking for siblings of the Unresolved-as-external defect. Full scope on the bead. You get this because you have now twice found a defect in a direction I had already blessed, both times read-only on a module you do not own, and the second one - the renormalization trap - would have shipped a bias in the opposite direction under my own approval. The internalRatio defect is almost certainly not unique. It is one instance of a general pattern: MODEL UNCERTAINTY SILENTLY RENDERED AS A SUBSTANTIVE FINDING ABOUT THE PARTICIPANT. For every number the module publishes, ask what the estimand is, where our uncertainty goes, and whether that number moves in a consistent direction when uncertainty correlates with a participant property such as vagueness or disorganisation. A yes to the third is the manufactured-group-difference failure and I will treat it as P1 on sight. Read-only, no claims, no edits - post findings and I rule. m1 owns the fix for the one already found.
